digest.component_or_area: rebar-implement skill and shared test-design documentation
propositions: Five prose upgrade blocks must be added to SKILL.md and test-design.md to address parity siblings, config miswiring, contention semantics, gate findings without oracle upgrades, and known gaps
Surface-parity census (4a) must enumerate five slots (CLI, MCP-API, library-facade, automated-callers, dual-direction) with in-scope-proven or out-of-scope-reason disposition
Config-effect contrast tests (test-design §6) must prove each config key changes behavior through the real read path via default vs non-default contrast, not merely parsing

Contention triggers (4b) must route by shape—composed/check-then-act writes to two_clones fixture, write-storm/retry-reclamation to storm suite, read-integrity-under-contention to sync_contention_harness—reusing existing shared suites
Gate findings must follow RED-test-first pattern for behavioral findings, with non-behavioral findings fixed directly without change-detector tests
Phase-5 residual-gap sweep must enumerate and disposition each item from 4a out-of-scope slots, 4b exclusions, and deferred 4g advisories as filed, accepted-with-reason, or fixed
